qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Proprietary systematic algorithms (AHL) and quant infrastructure provide an operating edge, but quant alpha decays rapidly under market arbitrage. Open-ended liquid hedge fund structures allow rapid LP redemptions during drawdown periods. Zero pricing power to raise management fees above inflation in an industry facing long-term structural fee compression.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Quantitative hedge fund manager with earnings heavily tied to volatile performance fees and cyclical trend-following alpha. Lacks structural pricing power in liquid alternatives, where institutional fee compression and redemption risks persist.
qualitative.evidence: Man Group manages $227B+ in AUM, but earnings are highly volatile due to performance fee swings ($281M-$310M/yr) and market cycles. Statutory net income swung from $608M in 2022 down to $234M in 2023 and $298M in 2024. Open-ended fund structures lack the multi-year locked-in capital of private markets, leaving fee income exposed to performance drawdowns and institutional fee compression.
